name: Flashpoint
choreography: Held cross-body coil into a horizontal empty-hand backhand; drifting follow-through, a rising palm fire lift at tick37, open-hand compression at65, and a final forward ignition at release84. Return into the approved almost-weightless idle. All fire is separate effect art; no physical sword.
requirements: Largest wrist travel from last startup to first active
Right hand performs horizontal backhand parallel with the ground
No sword, beam or invented flight of the caster
Nearly weightless toe-touch stance, fixed anatomical scale
Block and miss use opening withdrawal only
Native hit, mirrored, crouch block and whiff review
